line: Crowley's Eight of Disks is the card for the first decan of Virgo, with the Sun as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: The group text (pdf 180) gives the Sun in Virgo, and the attribution table agrees; the card chapter's own planet is set out in the section below.

quotes.quote: The Eight of Disks is called Prudence.
Its attribution is Sol in Virgo

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: It signifies intelligence lovingly applied to material matters

sections.title: A conflict in the text
sections.line: The chapter at pdf 234 gives Mercury for this card in Virgo, where the group text and the attribution table give the Sun. This page records the Sun, the reading the group text and the table agree on.

quotes.quote: he both rules and is exalted in the sign of Virgo
